definitions.explanation: An airplane designed to carry passengers on commercial flights, as opposed to cargo planes or military aircraft.

examples.japanese: {旅客機|りょかくき}が{空港|くうこう}に{着陸|ちゃくりく}した。
examples.english: The passenger plane landed at the airport.

examples.japanese: {大型|おおがた}{旅客機|りょかくき}は{数百人|すうひゃくにん}の{乗客|じょうきゃく}を{運|はこ}べる。
examples.english: A large passenger plane can carry several hundred passengers.

examples.japanese: {新型|しんがた}の{旅客機|りょかくき}は{燃費|ねんぴ}がよく、{環境|かんきょう}への{負荷|ふか}が{少|すく}ない。
examples.english: New passenger aircraft are fuel-efficient and place less burden on the environment.

notes:
USAGE:
The standard term for commercial passenger aircraft in news and formal contexts. In casual speech, {飛行機|ひこうき} (airplane) is used without distinguishing between passenger and other types.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大型|おおがた}{旅客機|りょかくき} (large passenger plane)
- {小型|こがた}{旅客機|りょかくき} (small passenger plane)
- {国際|こくさい}{旅客機|りょかくき} (international airliner)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飛行機|ひこうき}: airplane — general term
- {航空機|こうくうき}: aircraft — formal, includes all types
- {貨物機|かもつき}: cargo plane — for freight
